floorPlans.introduction: Explore the one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts, including podium and terrace variants. Each complete sheet preserves the apartment drawing, unit references, area table, key plan and developer notices.
floorPlans.note: Total area includes balcony or terrace space. Podium and upper-floor variants are separate choices; terrace totals do not describe internal suite area. Six matching layouts use Emaar’s official selected-plan PDF; the remaining fourteen use a clearly attributed Emaar-branded Petkovic copy. The selected sheet controls its source page and original PDF download. Confirm the signed unit plan and specifications with Emaar.
